notes: New plugins target Plugin API 1.17.0; Plugin API 1.10-1.16 packages remain loadable.
SDK 1.17.1 completes Core UI contracts for stable series, legend groups, group plots, active layout, semantic tables, tooltips, history and the typed Design System.
Multi-series ScientificPlot surfaces provide a Core-owned interactive legend by default; Core reserves legend footprint and exposes legend metrics.
PluginWorkspace safe mode keeps semantic Primary content reachable through Core-owned outer scrolling; contained mode remains available for intentionally bounded full-viewport surfaces.
ScientificCurveSurface minWidth/minHeight are preferred geometry, not a silent-render gate; Core may recover or render compactly.
Tool/TOP workspaces use one reusable dedicated window contract with Core-owned import, theme, viewport, navigation and status-bar geometry.
The SDK is standalone and does not require DK Data Studio source code.
